purpose: Provide a supplementary description for a single trigger using a positioned tooltip, with an optional richer text layout.
behaviorProvider: Base UI Tooltip Provider, Root, Trigger, Portal, Positioner and Popup.

requirements.statement: Support controlled open/onOpenChange or local defaultOpen, and use the supplied delay or owning-group delay token through the primitive provider.
Preserve an existing trigger aria-describedby and append the generated tooltip id while visible; render the popup with role=tooltip.
When disabled or content is null/undefined, return the original child unchanged without a tooltip trigger or popup.
Delegate hover/focus opening and dismissal to Base UI Tooltip; forward side and alignment and use group-token collision padding and offset for the portaled positioner.
RichTooltip composes title, description and optional kbd text inside Tooltip; it does not register the displayed shortcut or introduce an interactive popover workflow.
Supply one suitable element that accepts primitive props/ref and is accessible by keyboard when its tooltip is relevant. A disabled native control may require a separate focusable wrapper.
Give the trigger its own accessible name and keep essential instructions available without depending on hover. Use Popover or another suitable pattern for interactive content.
Apply controlled open callbacks and use meaningful supplementary text. The component does not infer whether external content has become stale or whether the trigger is enabled.
Own pattern or component styling consumes feedback group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No accessible-name substitute, persistent help surface or shortcut execution.
ReactNode content is flexible; the implementation does not reject interactive descendants, so hosts must choose the correct pattern.
Returning the original child when disabled does not disable that child.
